summary: Iteration 5 (Job Alerts) fully verified. Added 7 pytest cases in tests/test_job_alerts.py covering match scoring, draft->live transition, dedupe, RLS, mark-read isolation. Full backend suite: 42/42 passing (35 regression + 7 new). Frontend Playwright E2E validated the entire nurse alert flow via public URL: strong-profile nurse received a '100% match — ICU Nurse at UI Test Hospital, Mumbai' alert with emerald unread badge (count=1), popover click navigated to /nurse/jobs, mark-read cleared the badge on reload, hospital dashboard loads cleanly with the bell and does NOT call /api/alerts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 380 lines but doing a lot (auth + generic CRUD + alerts). Consider splitting into routes/, services/, and models/ modules if it grows further.

generate_job_alerts iterates every nurse_profile per publish (O(N) cursor scan). Fine at current scale; add an index on nurse_profiles + a coarse pre-filter (department/location) before scoring if the platform grows.

compute_match_score: if a job has no scoring criteria at all, function returns None and no alert is generated - correct, but silent. Consider logging when a job publish produces zero alerts for observability.
Threshold is 'strictly > 75' - intentional per spec, but the boundary is undocumented in the API. Add a short docstring/OpenAPI description so hospital-side UIs don't drift.

NotificationsBell: badge count = unread(alerts) + items.length. After opening popover, alerts are optimistically set to read but 'items' (interviews/apps) always contribute to badgeCount without a read concept. Not a bug for this iteration, but the mixed semantics of 'unread' vs 'total' in the badge is easy to misread.
test_credentials: Ephemeral TEST_<uuid>@example.com / StrongPass123! accounts created during the run (per test_credentials.md policy).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. All test data created via ephemeral registrations and cleaned up implicitly (document-level isolation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Job alerts feature is stable. tests/test_job_alerts.py is the regression suite for future changes. Threshold is strictly > 75 (score of exactly 75 yields no alert - intentional). Hospital NotificationsBell reuses the same component but does not call /api/alerts (guarded by role prop). If touching NotificationsBell, verify hospital reload produces zero /api/alerts requests.
